_fixture_metadata.description: Frozen examples of synthesis outputs from the AI layer. Used by test_synthesis_neutrality.py. The 'compliant' set must pass; the 'noncompliant' set must FAIL so we can prove the test actually catches violations.

compliant: Top career donor industries are Lawyers/Law Firms ($1.24M), Securities & Investment ($985K), and Pro-Israel ($720K). The member voted with the publicly stated position of those industries on 12 of 15 scored roll calls. Notable contradictions include a NO vote on HR-3456 (Securities & Investment industry favored YES) and a NO vote on HR-1213 (Health Professionals industry favored YES).

Donor concentration is moderate: the top five industries account for $3.97M of $6.20M in itemized career contributions. The member's alignment with those industries' stated positions across 15 scored votes is 80%.
